summaries.overview: Focused on completing Phase 1A (Contract Protection) in Enki: Implemented drag-drop upload for contracts/specs, parsing essentials (e.g., contract number, parties, scope) and risks (e.g., VOC, substrates), generation of To-Do items/exhibits, UI with tables/alerts, and Supabase 'jobs' table integration via JSONB. Addressed errors like null handling, slop detection for unexecuted contracts, and multi-file support.
keyAchievements: Developed full phase1a_page.tsx with UploadZone, parseFiles (Grok API stubs for essentials/risks), generateFromRisks for exhibits/To-Dos.
Fixed parsing issues: Slop/riders detection, multi-page extraction, scanned PDF skips, null guards in UI (e.g., toLocaleString).
UI enhancements: Tables for risks/To-Dos/exhibits, alerts for essentials, toasts for feedback.
DB alignment: Upsert to 'jobs' (essentials JSONB, to_do_items array), file storage paths tied to user_id/phase1a.
decisionsMade: Reuse patterns: Upload → parse (focus='essentials/risks') → generate (exhibits/To-Dos) → one-click stubs.
Waterproofing-specific: Risks include sequencing/lead times/VOC/substrates; optional specs for combined parsing.
Error handling: Warnings for slop/incomplete, no full scanned PDF support in Phase 1.
Architecture: Expert mode, Next.js/React with Supabase; no mobile/voice.

summaries.overview: Addressed Phase 1B (New Job Setup Wizard) issues in Enki: Focused on debugging Supabase storage upload failures (400 errors from RLS policies on 'enki-storage' bucket), created isolated test-storage page for verification, and outlined fixes for path alignment (e.g., 'jobs/user_uuid/phase1b/file.pdf'). Discussed extending RLS for phase-specific folders and finalizing storage design with metadata and soft deletes. Pending transition to Phase 1C after fixes.
keyAchievements: Identified root cause: Misaligned paths and default RLS violating policies; fixed in test-storage with bucket_id checks and auth.uid() folder prefixes.
Implemented working upload in test-storage/page.tsx: Success with signed URLs, debug logs, and metadata {phase, type}.
Defined RLS policies: INSERT/SELECT/UPDATE/DELETE using foldername[1] IN ('jobs', 'submittals', 'pds') and foldername[2] = concat('user_', auth.uid()).
Aligned with blueprint: Storage paths 'phaseX/job_id/user_uuid/file_type/file.pdf' for reuse across phases.
decisionsMade: Reuse test-storage logic in Phase 1B: Integrate into handleUpload for consistent paths and error handling.
Extend RLS for phases: Add 'phase1a', 'phase1b', etc., to foldername[1] allowlist.
Storage best practices: Use metadata {phase, type, jobId} for queries; soft deletes via deleted_at.
Expert mode focus: Web-first PWA, no mobile; waterproofing-specific (e.g., risks in later parses).

summaries.overview: Discussed gathering Product Data Sheets (PDS) for Enki's Phase 1C Manufacturer Product Database: Brainstormed scraping strategies for waterproofing vendors (Tremco, Sika, Henry, BASF, Carlisle), focusing on PDFs with VOC limits, lead times, compatibilities, costs, warranties. Developed modular Python/Selenium script for dynamic sites, with ethics (robots.txt), error handling, and metadata output for Supabase integration. Aligned with blueprint for spec matching/risk flagging (e.g., substrate incompatibilities).
keyAchievements: Ideated reliable scraping: Vendor-specific functions, Selenium for JS sites, BeautifulSoup for link extraction, PDF downloads to structured folders.
Provided full script: Main with config, parallel-safe runs, metadata CSV (e.g., product_name, VOC, scrape_date) for 'products' table upload.
Handled edge cases: Proxies/user-agents for anti-bot, retries/delays, change detection via HTML hashes, post-scrape PDF parsing stubs (PyPDF2 for VOC/warranties).
Ensured modularity: Functions for Tremco/Sika/Henry; extensible to others, with tests/mocks.
decisionsMade: Use Python 3.8+ with Selenium/BeautifulSoup/requests/PyPDF2; no external APIs to avoid costs/limits.
Ethical scraping: Check robots.txt, limit requests (10-20 PDFs/run), public PDS only; no overload.
Output design: Folders (/data/Vendor/Product/PDS.pdf), CSV for metadata; ZIP for Enki drag-drop.
Integration: Align with Phase 1C parse/generate (e.g., risks like 'Adhesive not for alkali concrete'); weekly cron for freshness.
